arguments.message:
Hi there! When you restore an authenticator app from a backup, the codes it generates won’t match the secret Meridian has on file. The fix is to reset your two‑factor authentication and set it up again:

1. In Meridian, go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Choose **Reset**.
3. Follow the normal enrollment steps – scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and enter the fresh six‑digit code to confirm.
4. Be sure to save the new recovery codes that are shown; they’re the only way to get back in if you lose access again.

Re‑enrolling creates a brand‑new secret, so the old QR code (and any restored codes) will no longer work. If you can’t reach the settings page because you don’t have a working code, you can use a saved recovery code to sign in and perform the reset.

Let me know if you need any more help!
